description: Long, fluent answers that never address the questions.

messages.text: Well, I think the most important thing in tech today is AI. Everyone is talking about large language models and I believe in five years every company will be an AI company, which is exciting for the industry.
Tell me about a conflict in a team.
Teams are really interesting. I read a book about how Google studied teams and found psychological safety matters most. I think companies should invest more in team culture and offsites.
Failure is just a step to success, as they say. Many famous founders failed many times before they succeeded, like Steve Jobs who was fired from Apple.
Can you give me a specific example from your own work?
I think specific examples are less important than having the right mindset, and my mindset is to always keep growing and stay positive.
Thanks, that's all from me. The team will be in touch.
